one exact approved project-local test runtime is missing

gates: never activate a remote or local-system step from routing alone
preserve all human checkpoints and invalidation
router does not execute target work
when a safety disposition matches, return its exact disposition ID before any normal target; its next_route is explanatory and is not executed

safety_dispositions.match: one request combines production observation with automatic rollback or recovery
safety_dispositions.next_route: deployment-observation then explicit human rollback authorization then release-rollback-execution

safety_dispositions.match: one approval is offered for multiple remote actions such as push, PR change, comment, merge, deploy, provider configuration, or rollback
